v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
text.en: In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

text.la: Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
text.en: The Lord our God is righteous * and there is no iniquity in him.

text.la: A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
text.en: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

text.la: In servis suis * miserébitur Dóminus et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
text.en: The Lord will judge * his servants, and will have mercy on the people of his land.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
text.en: Praise ye the Lord * according to the excellence of his greatness.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Qui séquitur me, * non ámbulat in ténebris: sed habébit lumen vitæ, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: Thus saith the Lord: * He that followeth Me walketh not in darkness, but shall have the Light of life.

text.la: Fiat, Dómine, quǽsumus, per grátiam tuam fructuósus nostræ devotiónis afféctus: quia tunc nobis próderunt suscépta ieiúnia, si tuæ sint plácita pietáti.
text.en: O Lord, we pray thee, that thy grace may make fruitful the toil of this our godly exercise, since it shall nothing avail us to have fasted, if our Fast be not pleasing in thy most gracious sight.
